name: Original Data Elements 6
definition: Data elements contained in the original message.|ISO 8583:1987 bit 90 and ISO 8583 1993/2003 bit 56.

MessageClass.name: Message Class
MessageClass.definition: Message class of the original message.

MessageFunction.name: Message Function
MessageFunction.definition: Identifies the type of process related to the message.

AcquirerIdentification.name: Acquirer Identification
AcquirerIdentification.definition: Code identifying the acquirer of the original message.

SenderIdentification.name: Sender Identification
SenderIdentification.definition: Code identifying the sender of the original message.

TransactionType.name: Transaction Type
TransactionType.definition: Type of transaction associated with the main service.

ConversionDateTime.name: Conversion Date Time
ConversionDateTime.definition: Date and Time of currency conversion.

AdditionalFee.name: Additional Fee
AdditionalFee.definition: Fees not included in the transaction amount.

ResponseCode.name: Response Code
ResponseCode.definition: Detailed results of the processing, conforming to ISO 8583 Response codes list.  This code list is maintained by the ISO 8583/MA (maintenance agency).

ApprovalCode.name: Approval Code
ApprovalCode.definition: Value assigned by the entity when the transaction is approved.

DeferredSettlementDate.name: Deferred Settlement Date
DeferredSettlementDate.definition: Deferred settlement date of the original transaction.
